findings.claim: The new hook toolchain cannot build because `tsc -p .` requires a TypeScript project file, but the diff adds no `.claude/hooks/tsconfig.json`.
findings.evidence: `.claude/hooks/package.json` adds `"build": "tsc -p ."`; the diff adds package files, `src/lib/agent-lint.mts`, `src/lint-agents.mts`, and tests, but no `tsconfig.json`, while acceptance criterion 3.1 requires the workflow to run `build`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `.claude/hooks/tsconfig.json` with the expected module/output settings, or change the build script to invoke `tsc` with explicit options that do not require a project file.

findings.claim: Several npm scripts and tests reference runtime files that are not added by this diff, so the documented checks fail on a fresh checkout.
findings.evidence: `package.json` defines `check:dist` as `node scripts/check-dist.mjs`, `scan:prometheus` as `node dist/scan-prometheus.mjs`, and `lint:agents` as `node dist/lint-agents.mjs`; `test/lint-agents.test.mjs` imports `../dist/lib/agent-lint.mjs`, but the diff adds no `scripts/check-dist.mjs`, no `dist/` files, and no `scan-prometheus` source/runtime file. Acceptance criteria 1.2 and 3.1 require `node .claude/hooks/dist/lint-agents.mjs`, `check:dist`, `lint:agents`, and `scan:prometheus` to succeed.
findings.suggested_fix: Commit the generated `.claude/hooks/dist/*.mjs` files and the missing `scripts/check-dist.mjs`/scan implementation, or update scripts/tests/workflow to build and reference files that exist.

findings.claim: The agent-tooling workflow does not run the required build step.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 3.1 says the workflow must run `npm ci, build, test, check:dist, lint:agents, scan:prometheus`; the workflow runs `npm --prefix .claude/hooks ci`, then `npm --prefix .claude/hooks run check:dist`, `test`, `lint:agents`, and `scan:prometheus`, with no `npm --prefix .claude/hooks run build` step.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a workflow step running `npm --prefix .claude/hooks run build` in the required sequence, or update the acceptance criterion if `check:dist` is intended to replace build.

findings.claim: The disallowed-tools check misses a direct conflict when only one of `Edit` or `Write` is disallowed.
findings.evidence: `lintAgent` only reports a conflict when `disallowed.has("Edit") && disallowed.has("Write") && (tools.has("Edit") || tools.has("Write"))`; therefore `tools: Edit` with `disallowedTools: Edit` is silently accepted.
findings.suggested_fix: Check each disallowed tool independently, e.g. report when any `asList(fm["disallowedTools"])` entry is also present in `tools`.
